'''Larus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]], he recruited a Republic hero for collecting and defusing unexploded bombs scattered by a shipwreck near the spaceport.
